boykopovar/anyps5.caption:
Comment “PS5” and I’ll DM you the link to this repo.

There’s a repo that can turn a PS5 game into a PC program. No emulator.

It’s called AnyPS5. It converts the game’s program into a normal Windows or Linux program and reimplements the system libraries the game calls, like Proton does for Windows
